title: Spec: Gherkin for CLI and SDK surfacing of STE findings
description: Spec-first. Scenarios: limatus diagnose with an STE profile emits STE kinds in the validated JSON; the SDK diagnose() call exposes the same; profile validation errors are reported on load; no rewrite payloads in diagnosis output.

comments.author: example-user
comments.text: Spec complete: Gherkin scenarios codify CLI and SDK surfacing of STE findings (SDK diagnose returns the asdSte100 summary and asd_ kinds; the example profile fixture runs end to end). These are regression specs of landed behavior, verified green: 31 asd-ste100 scenarios pass.
